answer: Before the stamp comes 300 stamped dockets, each costing $9 to have checked, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. The desk only stamps a name that carries Currentbound clearing agent beacon charter, and the stamp itself rests on a charter agents file after harbour checks. A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. ledge stays on the record. The tally keeps umber. canyon is written on the receipt.
